sources.supportingExcerpt: Visa requirements for travel to Grenada are based on your country of citizenship.

sources.title: Visa Requirements for Traveling to Grenada
sources.publisher: Embassy of Grenada in the United States
sources.officialityEvidence: Grenada's currently linked Embassy schedule is marked updated April 2024 and directly lists Bolivia as Prior to Arrival.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Bolivia (Plurinational State of) Prior to Arrival

sources.title: Visas to Jordan: nationality table
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Visit Jordan nationality table is published by the Jordan Tourism Board and gives nationality-specific visitor-visa procedures.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Bolivia | Applicable | Visa can be obtained upon arrival, it will cost a total of 40 JOD.

sources.title: Immigration and visas
sources.publisher: Embassy of Panama in the United States
sources.officialityEvidence: Panama's live Embassy visitor page names Bolivia in its no-visa-required cohort and states the visitor stay limit.
sources.supportingExcerpt: No Visa Required ... Bolivia ... maximum amount of time ... three (3) months.

policies.title: Bolivian ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's actively linked April 2024 Embassy schedule places Bolivia in its Prior to Arrival cohort.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Bolivian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Grenada defines Prior to Arrival as a visa obtained at a Grenadian mission or consulate before travel.
Work, study, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Bolivian ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan Tourism Board's live nationality table expressly says Bolivian visitors can obtain a visa on arrival for 40 JOD.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Bolivian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Jordan says non-Jordanian visitors must register with Gateway2Jordan and receive a QR code before departure.
Work, residence, special documents, border restrictions and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Bolivian ordinary passports: Panama visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy visitor schedule names Bolivia in its no-visa-required cohort.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Bolivian passport holder travelling as a short visitor for up to three months.
Passport validity, funds, onward travel and final admission remain governed by Panama's authorities.
